findings.one_line: In the both-targeted converse, the case where the first descendants v=w as observed vertices occur in different components is not covered: the displayed path assumes one common copy; add the y-bridged path (a,l)->(v,l)<-y->(v,l')<-(b,l') (with both copies opened by C-descendants).

cited_checks.note: The supplied verbatim Theorem 3.2 states the same barred-set d-separation-to-CI implication for a mixture DAG and mixture distribution; instantiating it with the post-intervention component DAGs yields the node's quantifiers.
